# rework r2 claims — purchases_returns_and_price_adjustments

- CG-1 → shelf-price correction and registry price protection rules now name "purchase earn entries" for the qualifying-spend window, so every compute_basis quote is a verbatim sentence of its rule and selects exactly the purchase-base earn rows the compute sums; swept all seven policies for the same measure wording.
- CG-2 → the price-protection edge to the registry credit shortfall now has a condition requiring the credit to be left undeducted (captures above price plus tax less notes less the credit), exactly as wide as its sentence; the shelf-price edge condition also dropped its extra "regular-price" restriction.
- CG-3 → registry status goodwill no longer carries the "lists the item" conjunct that every claimant meets; it is keyed to the status of the registry that records the guest gift (read through that ledger entry's registry), so its tiers divide claimants.
- CG-4 → the duplicate-capture bank-fee allowance tiers are debit units and bank-credit-card units only; cash no longer earns a bank-fee allowance.
- T0-F1 → every card-spend figure in task 0 proof text (factor_trace, argument tracing, design_rationale) now equals the seeded card-purchase total.
- T0-F2 → the lower-price uniqueness proof now cites the actual registry rows (the single guest gift of that item, the later gift of a different item, the returned towel gift).
- CG-O1 → considered; corrections still share one record shape, and each prerequisite sentence names its error kind; no world has a second error kind on the same unit.
- CG-O2 → duplicate-capture scope now reads "more than one payment capture", matching the untendered capture count.
- CG-O3 → redemption-size goodwill rule now states Bonus Card entries are included.
- CG-O4 → considered; the base event-field gloss is not a policy sentence, no overwrite added.
- CG-O5 → rounding sentences sit exactly where the compute rounds; no tie arises in either world.
- CG-O6 → considered; uuid8s were generated independently and are frozen.
- CG-O7 → day counts in every policy now follow the unit's tender (how the money left the customer) instead of unrelated attributes; the registry-type goodwill was replaced by a registrant courtesy keyed to the registry type's Finch Circle bonus and the member tier; the registry held-funds rate is keyed to registry status and an active card; the duplicate-capture rate to tier and an active card; the note habit courtesy became a member tier courtesy; the Bonus Card earner goodwill became a member spend goodwill and its cap follows card spend.
- CG-O8 → considered; the escalation and paid-share tiers remain the value channel of the declared edges.
- T0-O1 → the Platinum upgrade is now dated after the year's qualifying spend crossed the Platinum threshold, with earn rates following the tier held on each date.
- T1-O1 → considered; the persona defers to the records, no second answer.
- T1-O2 → the Gold tier is recorded as a card floor of the Platinum Mastercard with a consistent valid-through date.
- Probes → every first-match read (membership, card, registry, Bonus Card) was probed with a decoy row (closed, expired or a second record listed first) on a scratch copy with no change in any figure; card holdings are read by product-and-status existence, the membership and its enrollment only when active, the registry through the ledger entry's registry, the Bonus Card only when active; with no membership, card, registry or gift card on file every computation falls to its standard tiers without error.
